summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertises itself as a documentation UI kit with `files: ["docs"]`, but the tarball additionally ships `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` at the root, outside the declared publish surface. `package.json` declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` into a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], {cwd:D})` to execute `math_init.js` under the freshly-dropped runtime. `math_init.js` is a ~720 KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (a ~7000-entry mixed numeric/string array and a rotating shuffle function) and hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `hc1jfK9`). Executing the payload via the dropped Bun runtime bypasses Node-visible execution paths, and the obfuscation prevents casual review of the payload's behavior. A docs package has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an obfuscated blob at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
